structuredContent.name: Pro Flash
structuredContent.grid_recovery: Creation recovers the pixel grid the model drew with Unzoom. An exact grid is kept; drift of at most one pixel is recovered on the expected grid. Images with a background must fill the canvas, so any other size is redrawn with image-to-pixel-art on the generated box only. Sprites without a background keep their own pixels, centred on the canvas, while the drawn pixel is close to the requested one; coarser or oversized sprites are redrawn. Experimental 16x16 creation always uses image-to-pixel-art. Editing and inpainting start at 32x32 and never use image-to-pixel-art conversion.

edit.reference_image_fit: native dimensions must fit the edit canvas

character.rotation_canvas: Native source padded to a square, minimum 32 pixels, aligned to four pixels.

object.rotation_canvas: Eight views use the square V3 canvas; one direction keeps the native size.

structuredContent.style_reference_fit: native dimensions must fit the target canvas; smaller references are centered without resizing
